response.sql:
WITH project_source_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p.fundflux, '<missing>') AS funding_source,
    ss.boxy / NULLIF(ss.boxz, 0) AS ratio
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
), source_stats AS (
  SELECT
    funding_source,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(ratio) AS size
  FROM project_source_ratios
  GROUP BY funding_source
), sized_sources AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(size) OVER () AS avg_size
  FROM source_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
  SUM(size) AS combined_size,
  AVG(size - avg_size) AS avg_excess_size
FROM sized_sources
WHERE size > avg_size;

assumptions.assumption: “Size” means the number of non-missing boxy/boxz ratios per funding source, and missing funding sources are grouped together using the sentinel '<missing>'.
